report.v2.title: CS2 Match Review
report.v2.comparison: Scores compare eligible teammates in this match. Enemy metrics are context only and do not enter ranking.
report.v2.positioning_note: Positioning score reflects rifle movement discipline and utility deaths per round.
report.v2.flash_overview: {throws} thrown · {enemies} enemies blinded · {teammates} teammates blinded · {self_blinds} self-blinds.
diagnosis.rifle_moving: You fired {percentage:.1f}% of your rifle shots while moving. Rifles are inaccurate when moving—stop completely before shooting.
diagnosis.sniper_moving: You fired {percentage:.1f}% of your sniper rifle shots while moving. Make sure you are fully stopped before firing.
diagnosis.awp_unscoped: You fired {count} AWP shots without scoping. Make sure you are scoped before shooting.
diagnosis.submachine_gun_low_moving: You only moved during {percentage:.1f}% of your submachine gun shots. Use your speed to make yourself a harder target.
diagnosis.submachine_gun_high_moving: You are running and firing in almost every submachine gun fight. Close the distance before taking long-range fights.
diagnosis.pistol_long_range: You had {count} long-range kills with the Five-SeveN/Tec-9. Try to play closer to cover.
diagnosis.deagle_usp_moving: You fired {percentage:.1f}% of your Desert Eagle/USP shots while moving. Try to be stationary when you shoot.
diagnosis.flash_team_harm: You threw {throws} flashbangs this match; {harmful} blinded a teammate or yourself. Check the timing and lineups so they do not affect teammates.
diagnosis.rifle_body_hits: Your {weapon} hit the chest or stomach on {percentage:.1f}% of recorded hits. Start your spray at head level and check the weapon visual below.
diagnosis.no_obvious_errors: This match data does not show obvious repeated errors. Review more matches to see whether patterns emerge.
summary.rifle_moving: {moving} of {total} rifle shots were fired while moving ({percentage:.1f}%).
summary.flash: {throws} flashbangs thrown; {enemies} enemies blinded; {teammates} teammates blinded.
text.crosshair_settling_one: You fired before your crosshair settled on the enemy once. Try to stop your mouse before clicking.
text.crosshair_settling_many: You fired before your crosshair settled on the enemy {count} times. Try to stop your mouse before clicking.
hitmap.choose_weapon: Choose weapon for bullet hit map
hitmap.no_data: No categorized hit data for this player.
hitmap.description: Each mark represents one hit. Placement is approximated by hit area; hover over a mark to see where it landed.
narrative.insufficient: A playstyle cannot be assigned confidently because this player has too few rounds or shots. Collect more match data first.
narrative.missing_stats: Playstyle: {archetype}. Performance context is unavailable because required statistics are missing: {missing}.
narrative.impact.low: Low impact needs direct correction: K/D is {kd:.2f} and ADR is {adr:.1f}.
narrative.impact.high: This playstyle delivered strong impact: K/D is {kd:.2f} and ADR is {adr:.1f}.
narrative.impact.steady: This playstyle produced steady impact: K/D is {kd:.2f} and ADR is {adr:.1f}.
narrative.rusher.praise: You seek fights quickly and play with clear initiative.
narrative.rusher.pivot: Your aim can struggle to keep up with your speed during fast engagements.
narrative.rusher.goal: Settle your crosshair briefly before firing while maintaining your aggressive pace.
narrative.patient.praise: Your measured shots show precision and control.
narrative.patient.pivot: A cautious approach can mean missed opportunities to take space early in the round.
narrative.patient.goal: Look for chances to take space earlier without sacrificing careful aim.
narrative.aggressive_marksman.praise: You combine proactive engagements with precise shot-making.
narrative.aggressive_marksman.pivot: Choose rounds where your aggression can create impact while maintaining accuracy.
narrative.aggressive_marksman.goal: Practice fast entries with a settled crosshair and commit to engagements that create space for your team.
narrative.tactical_anchor.praise: You provide a stable foundation for your team's defense.
narrative.tactical_anchor.pivot: Look for opportunities to affect the round more proactively.
narrative.tactical_anchor.goal: Identify moments to push forward when the enemy is out of position.
narrative.disciplined_anchor.praise: You hold positions with patience and discipline.
narrative.disciplined_anchor.pivot: A disciplined hold can still give up space when there is a safe chance to move forward.
narrative.disciplined_anchor.goal: Look for controlled opportunities to take space and support your teammates.
narrative.all_rounder.praise: You adapt to different situations and roles on the team.
narrative.all_rounder.pivot: Finding one area to develop further could help your contributions stand out.
narrative.all_rounder.goal: Choose one skill to focus on over your next few matches and track how it affects your rounds.
